effect_description_eng: ＜Execute＞ ＜Ascension＞ (When this Digimon is deleted, you may place this card as the top security card.) [Security] [On Deletion] Delete 1 of your opponent's Digimon with the lowest level. If this effect didn't delete, trash their top security card. [When Digivolving] [When Attacking] [Once Per Turn] By trashing 2 bottom face-down cards from under any of your Tamers, activate 1 [Main] effect on this card's Option side.

option.effect_text: ＜Use Req. ([Glowing Dawn] trait)＞ (Specified conditions meet color requirements.) [Main] Delete 1 of your opponent's level 6 or higher Digimon. Then, you may play 1 play cost 4 or lower [BEATBREAK] trait card from your trash without paying the cost.
